mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_TYPE_MAP WHERE DATA_TYPE = #{dataType} AND DBMS_TP = #{dbmsTp}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DATA_TYPE_MAP (DATA_TYPE, DBMS_TP, PHYS_DATA_TYPE, DFLT_DATA_LEN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{dataType}, #{dbmsTp}, #{physDataType}, #{dfltDataLen, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{now}, #{userId}, #{now}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_DATA_TYPE_MAP WHERE DATA_TYPE = #{dataType} AND DBMS_TP = #{dbmsTp}
mapper.select: SELECT CONF_KEY as "confKey" ,CONF_VAL as "confVal" ,CONF_DESC as "confDesc" ,UPDT_DT as "updtDt" ,UPDT_USER_ID as "updtUserId" FROM TB_SYS_CONF WHERE CONF_KEY = #{confKey}
SELECT D.DS_ID as "dsId" ,D.DSN as "dsn" ,D.DBMS_TP as "dbmsTp" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL M JOIN ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE D ON D.DS_ID = M.DM_DS_ID WHERE M.DM_ID = #{dmId}

SELECT O.DM_ID as dataModelId ,O.OBJ_OWNER as objOwner ,O.OBJ_NM as objNm ,O.OBJ_NM_KR as objNmKr ,O.OBJ_DESC as objDesc ,O.OBJ_COMMENT as objComment ,O.TABLESPACE_NM as tablespaceNm FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O WHERE O.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND COALESCE(O.OBJ_OWNER, '') = #{objOwner} AND O.OBJ_NM = #{objNm}

SELECT A.ATTR_NM as attrNm ,A.ATTR_NM_KR as attrNmKr ,A.DATA_TYPE as dataType ,A.DATA_LEN as dataLen ,A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN as dataDecimalLen ,A.NULLABLE_YN as nullableYn ,A.DEFAULT_VAL as defaultVal ,A.PK_YN as pkYn ,A.ATTR_COMMENT as attrComment ,A.ATTR_ORD as attrOrder FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A WHERE A.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') = #{objOwner} AND A.OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND COALESCE(A.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY A.ATTR_ORD, A.ATTR_NM

SELECT OBJ_OWNER AS "objOwner", TABLE_NM AS "tableNm", CONSTRAINT_NM AS "constraintNm", CONSTRAINT_TYPE AS "constraintType", COLUMN_NM AS "columnNm", COLUMN_POS AS "columnPos", REF_OWNER AS "refOwner", REF_TABLE_NM AS "refTableNm", REF_COLUMN_NM AS "refColumnNm", DELETE_RULE AS "deleteRule" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = #{objOwner} AND TABLE_NM = #{objNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NM, COLUMN_POS
